scope: Черникова, июль–сентябрь: состав заказов сохранён, текущие цены и правила пересчитаны сценарно; улучшены только восемь рецептур.
method: FC = recipe material including embedded set packaging / allocated food payment after discounts and redeemed points. Unpriced water and out-of-card fryer oil not estimated. No payroll, delivery, commissions or taxes.

assumptions: All scenarios retain observed Q3 basket quantities and promotion-family choice per observed Starter order; future demand and guest switching are not forecast.

Actual current menu prices apply where exact normalized names are verified; unknown current prices use historical iiko gross per physical root unit as an explicitly flagged proxy. Complete-price subset is separately usable.
Current gift-ladder reward/thresholds replace historical gifts only in orders that historically used this family; highest currently eligible ladder level recomputed on repriced paid basket.

Bonus RUB are the observed spend, capped at50% current eligible basket. Delivery/service cash rows are excluded from food gift thresholds, bonus eligibility and product realization. No new bonus awards are charged as instant cash cost or invented as available balances. Separate sensitivity preserves historical spend share.

Absolute campaign date validity checked at21Oct; day-of-week eligibility uses each replayed historic basket weekday. Expired/disabled rules are not current monetary discounts. Percentage rules preserve each historic order effective eligible share because Starter field price/totalPrice and extra-item eligibility differ. This is an explicit scenario basis proxy, not a reproduction of the production rule engine.

Monetary discounts allocated to positive-price roots proportionally to current gross; bonuses allocate only to eligible roots (lighter promo bundles/pizza combos get no bonus reduction); explicit free gifts get no attributed revenue. Original iiko may distribute a gift discount across paid and free items; therefore SKU net need not match prior OLAP allocation.
Non-Starter orders preserve each order observed iiko net/gross ratio and are explicitly tagged. This does not prove bonus cash adjustments for those channels.
Unmatched Starter items and edited POS cash mismatches remain flagged; strict matched fully priced subset can be evaluated independently.
A fixed menu/mix/cohort counterfactual is not observed October FC or a promise of stable perpetual savings.

wholeline.scope: Entire historical rollline under per-order current/light replay quantities, actual iiko selected child sources once, current21Oct recipes and common same-date pricebook; target8 recipes improved, remaining roll recipes unchanged. Recipe boxes/extras included once. Other order packaging not imputed. Water remains explicitly unpriced.
wholeline.revenue_allocation: Plain commercial roll/set revenue retained once. Mixed bundle observed per-order branch food shares are fixed historical boundary shares and do not depend on improved recipe food. Nonroll product revenue is retained as a separate residual; cash-only delivery/service fees excluded before product-FC revenue.
